name: Wolves at Our Heels
summary: Lars at Sven's Camp faces hungry, rabid dire wolves in western Duskwood. Hunting them gives Lars room to gather food while he and Sven Yorgen pursue their vendetta against the necromancer Morbent Fel.

sections.title: A Precarious Camp
sections.body: Sven Yorgen and Lars keep an isolated camp in the western hills of Duskwood, near the Westfall border. They live far from Darkshire and rely on their own hunting and foraging to survive. Lars carries fresh game through the dark woods, where ravenous predators prowl the riverbanks and underbrush.

sections.title: Clearing the Woods
sections.body: Starving, rabid dire wolves prowl north and east of the camp, toward the river. Killing the frenzied beasts eases the danger to Lars as he hunts. With less need to fight for their daily food, Sven and Lars can focus on Morbent Fel, the necromancer farther east.

aliases: who gives wolves at our heels
faq.answer: Lars helps Sven Yorgen at their small camp in the hills of western Duskwood. He hunts and forages for their daily needs while Sven fixates on vengeance against the dark forces threatening the region.
Dire wolves prowl the woods north and east of Sven's Camp, especially along the riverbanks that divide Duskwood from the zones to the north.

faq.q: Why are the dire wolves so aggressive?
faq.answer: Duskwood's wilderness has grown harsher under an encroaching shadow. Scarce game leaves the dire wolves near starvation, while disease or dark corruption has made many rabid and recklessly violent toward anyone carrying fresh meat.

aliases: who is the necromancer to the east
faq.answer: Morbent Fel is a powerful necromancer who practices dark arts from the cemetery and mounds to the east. Sven and Lars bear him a bitter grudge and prepare to take him down once their basic needs are met.

faq.q: What are the Flash Bundles Lars gives as a reward?
faq.answer: Flash Bundles are blinding devices made by the townsfolk of Darkshire. Sympathetic residents donated them to Sven's camp to aid his fight against the undead and beasts infesting the woods.

faq.q: Why don't Sven and Lars live in Darkshire?
faq.answer: Sven's family suffered a tragedy that made him an embittered, driven vigilante. Sven and Lars live in the wild, rather than under the Night Watch's protection in Darkshire, so they can stalk the evils plaguing the woods firsthand.

angles.text: As a hunter, you need sharp awareness to tame or cull Duskwood's warped wildlife. These dire wolves are more desperate and vicious than ordinary forest beasts.
As an Alliance traveler, you help steady Lars's remote camp and secure an allied staging ground against the undead forces plaguing western Duskwood.
